note: Measured on the four camera-made example photos from the HP5 recipe post, as 799px web copies (downscaled from ~6240px, so grain is largely averaged out). Luma (L) percentiles out of 255. These are targets to sanity check the filter against, not a fit.

target_ranges_across_the_four.hard_rules: no clipped highlights (max well below 255), blacks lifted slightly, never crushed to 0
target_ranges_across_the_four.scene_dependent_do_not_fit: median, white ceiling and spread depend on the scene (fog vs overcast vs interior), so they are not filter constants

current_filter_output_on_9_test_photos.note: p0.5 above 18 occurs only on scenes with no real shadows (arcade, museum). The 182 at the low end is the garden photo, slightly under the reference top-end range of 186. Contrast is at the low edge of the reference range after the highlight reduction.
